title: Activity
description: Schema for Activity (L3) entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-processes. CR-BP-32. An Activity is a cohesive grouping of work within a Business Process that provides a meaningful logical unit of process structure without constituting an independently defined Business Process. Activity is the intermediate logical decomposition between the canonical L2 Business Process and the atomic L4 Task. Activity is a CATALOG-OWNED record type; it is NOT a metamodel entity. The canonical structural relationship is `L2 BusinessProcess --[dea:composes]--> L3 Activity --[dea:composes]--> L4 Task` (CR-BP-32 §7). Composition is structural only; it does NOT imply execution order, temporal sequence, organizational ownership, automation, or system implementation (CR-BP-32 §7, §11). L4 is the decomposition boundary; anything below belongs to implementation detail outside the catalog (CR-BP-32 §12).

type.description: Discriminator. Always 'Activity' for Activity entries. Mirrors the discriminators used by `dea:ProcessContext` (type: ProcessContext), `dea:ProcessGroup` (type: ProcessGroup), `dea:BusinessProcess` (type: Process).

id.description: Stable Activity id. CR-BP-04 §4 family convention: dea:activity-<kebab-name>. The id must be stable across renames of name/cohesion_rationale; renames go through the CR-programme.

name.description: Activity name. Per CR-BP-32 §9 the catalog prefers a consistent gerund or equivalent activity-oriented form (e.g. 'Validate Order', 'Assess Customer Eligibility', 'Prepare Fulfilment', 'Confirm Delivery'). Naming conventions do NOT determine semantic classification.

definition.description: Normative semantic meaning of this Activity. Not a description; a definition. ACT-001..010 rely on this being non-overlapping with peer Activities under the same Business Process.

belongs_to_business_process.description: Reference to the parent Business Process (dea:process-* id family). ACT-001 enforces presence + pattern. The parent BP must declare this Activity in `metadata.activity_references[]` or in a `composes[]` entry whose target_id matches this Activity id (ACT-010 bidirectional traceability).

cohesion_rationale.description: Normative rationale for why the constituent work belongs together as a meaningful logical unit (CR-BP-32 §6). ACT-003 enforces minimum length (≥ 20 chars; rationale, not label).

composes.description: Canonical structural composition (CR-BP-32 §7). Every entry declares that this Activity composes a Task. Each entry conforms to the metamodel relationship-instance shape (source_id, target_id, relationship_type, plus optional direction, status, effective_from/to, asserted_by, rationale, evidence, provenance). ACT-005 enforces `relationship_type: dea:composes`. The forbidden alternatives `parent_activity`, `child_activities`, `decomposes`, `contains_activity` are rejected.

target_id.description: Target Task id. CR-BP-32 §12 establishes L4 (Task) as the decomposition boundary. CR-BP-33 will introduce the Task record type; until then, target_id values referencing `dea:task-*` are validated by ACT-004 only when at least one such record exists in the catalog.

decomposition_boundary.description: Optional marker asserted when an Activity has no composed Tasks and decomposition terminates at the Activity itself (CR-BP-32 §12). ACT-004 accepts this marker as an alternative to a non-empty `composes[]`.

version.description: SemVer version. Same constraint as the entity schema (SIV-001).

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle state. LCM-001 vocabulary. Activities inherit the same lifecycle as BPs/PGs/PCs.

status.description: Legacy status field. LCM-002 enforces consistency with `lifecycle_status` (identical, or both in legacy compatibility set).

ecfConformance.description: ECF Conformance Gate manifest (CR-ECF-CG-001..004), mirrored from schemas/entity.schema.json. An Activity inherits its ECF coordinate from the parent Business Process (belongs_to_business_process); the block is declared on the record itself because scripts/check_ecf_conformance.py enforces presence on every canonical entity file under entities/v1-alpha/. canonicalReferences must match the parent BP's coordinate.

metadata.description: Optional metadata block. The validator (ACT-001..010) tolerates `metadata.belongs_to_business_process` and `metadata.cohesion_rationale` as alternatives to top-level placement. Other metadata fields are tolerated but not interpreted.

activity_references.description: Mirror of the parent BP's reverse-reference list. Not used on Activity records themselves; documented here for completeness because ACT-010 reads this field on the parent BP.

change_history.description: Audit trail for lifecycle transitions. Same convention as BP / PG records (LCM-003 / LCM-004).
